description: This release contains critical playback, playlist import, and Spotify login fixes that make the app significantly more reliable.

changelog.title: 🔴 Critical Fixes
items: Song playback restored — fixed stream client pre-flight probe blocking all fallback clients
Stream URL expiry null no longer silently discards valid URLs (defaults to 6 hours)
30-second timeout on URL resolver prevents IO thread deadlock when multiple songs load simultaneously
Partially downloaded tracks no longer trigger unnecessary network re-fetches

changelog.title: 🟠 Import & Login
items: Playlist import: track search retries 3× with backoff before dropping a song
Playlist import: interrupted transactions no longer leave playlists empty
Spotify login (phone): Chrome desktop User-Agent removes WebView fingerprint — OTP SMS now delivered
Spotify login (email): security-verification redirect correctly handled, login completes
Spotify login: loading indicator shown during OTP and verification pages
